scope: Expanded primary manufacturer, owner and measurement references; candidate research only. This catalog does not change the frozen recording sessions or confer calibration/training rights. Earlier v1 leads remain active; this file adds research records and does not replace their history.
classification: Catalogs, reported scalar measurements, methods and media leads are separate from acquired/qualified audio. Indexed sources and failed retrievals are labeled.
